## What we do

CHS Roofing installs, repairs, and maintains residential and commercial roofs
across Southwest Florida. We work on every common Florida roof system:
asphalt shingle, standing-seam metal, exposed-fastener metal (5V crimp),
concrete/clay tile, TPO, modified bitumen, EPDM, and reflective silicone /
acrylic coating systems. We're licensed to the current Florida wind code and
BBB accredited A+.

## Services

- Roof replacement / new installation — shingle, metal, tile, flat
- Roof repair — starting at $250. Leaks, missing shingles, storm damage,
  flashing, pipe boots, tile / metal / flat repairs
- Free 21-point roof inspection with written report
- Emergency storm response — same-day tarping, insurance-claim documentation
- Roof coating & restoration (silicone / acrylic on TPO, modified bitumen,
  EPDM, metal). Typically 40–60% less than a full replacement for eligible
  substrates
- Roof maintenance plans (Basic / Pro / Premium)
- Gutter installation and replacement (seamless aluminum, color-matched)

## Materials specialties

- GAF certified shingle installer (System Plus 50-year warranty available)
- Standing-seam and 5V-crimp metal installations (Galvalume, painted, +$160/sq
  color upgrade on quotes)
- Concrete and clay tile — tile-on-tile and tile-to-metal conversions

## Counties and permitting

CHS Roofing pulls permits in four Southwest Florida jurisdictions:
- Lee County (Cape Coral, Fort Myers, North Fort Myers, Lehigh Acres, Estero, Bonita Springs)
- Collier County (Naples, Marco Island)
- Charlotte County (Punta Gorda, Port Charlotte)
- Sarasota County (Sarasota, North Port, Venice, Osprey, Englewood) and the City of Sarasota,
  which permits separately from the county
